basic_info.name: جامعة الشرق الأوسط
basic_info.website_note: Domain mu.edu.jo does not resolve; official website is meu.edu.jo

admission_requirements.general_requirements: General Secondary Education Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent; minimum 60% for most majors, 65% for Law, 80% for Pharmacy and Engineering. Non-Jordanian students may be admitted with up to 10 marks less than the Jordanian minimum. Community College diploma holders accepted with qualifying exam average >= 68% (70% for Pharmacy/Engineering). Placement tests in Arabic, English, and Computer required at first enrollment.
admission_requirements.exam_details: Placement tests in Arabic, English, and Computer are administered at first enrollment semester (25 JD per test). Students who pass are exempted from remedial courses. Students scoring 80%+ are exempted from both remedial course (099) and first-level course (101).
admission_requirements.english_requirement: Placement test in English at first enrollment (no separate IELTS/TOEFL requirement for admission)

colleges: Faculty of Arts and Educational Sciences
majors_overview.uk_hosted_programs: Hosted programmes with University of Bedfordshire (UK) and University of Strathclyde

tuition_fees.fee_structure_notes: Registration fee 500 JD per regular semester (300 JD summer); enrollment fee 75 JD (paid once); refundable fee 75 JD (paid once); health insurance free; transportation free; placement tests 25 JD each. Non-Jordanian students pay additional 30 JD per semester.

major_fee_categories.arts_and_educational_sciences: 50-90 JD per credit hour (Arabic Literature 50, English Literature 80, Applied Translation 90, Education Tech 70, Sports Management 70)
major_fee_categories.business: 80-90 JD per credit hour (Business Admin 80, Accounting 85, others 90)
major_fee_categories.information_technology: 90-100 JD per credit hour (Computer Science 90, Software Engineering/Cyber Security/AI 100)
major_fee_categories.media: 70-80 JD per credit hour (Journalism/TV 70, Digital Media 80)
major_fee_categories.engineering_and_design: 90-110 JD per credit hour (Renewable Energy 90, Architecture/Biomedical 110, Graphic Design 90, Interior Design 100)
major_fee_categories.pharmacy: 130 JD per credit hour (Pharmacy), 100 JD (Cosmetic Chemical Products)
major_fee_categories.allied_medical_sciences: 80-100 JD per credit hour (Nutrition 80, Physiotherapy/Medical Analysis/Genetic Eng 100, Paramedic 90)

tuition_fees.notes: Registration fee 500 JD per regular semester for bachelor programs; enrollment fee 75 JD (paid once); refundable fee 75 JD (paid once); health insurance free; free transportation; placement tests 25 JD each

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE) - generally and privately accredited; Association of Arab Universities; Union of Arab and International Universities
ranking_accreditation.programmatic_accreditations: AACSB (Faculty of Business); FIBAA (Faculty of Engineering - multiple programs); CEA (Faculty of Arts and Educational Sciences - Arabic language); NCAAA (Faculty of IT); Philippine Accrediting Association (Pharmacy)
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: QS World University Rankings #1001-1200 (2027); QS Arab Region Rankings #91; THE Impact Rankings 801-1000 (2025)

market_demand.notes: University hosts annual Career Day with 60+ participating companies; runs hosted programs with University of Bedfordshire (UK) and University of Strathclyde; new majors added in 2025-2026 include Genetic Engineering & Biotechnology, Paramedical & Emergency Science, Business & Psychology, Biomedical Engineering

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No on-campus accommodation mentioned on official website
campus_facilities.sports_details: Olympic Stadium, indoor sports courts, outdoor sport courts and pitches, fitness gym, Next Level Arena
other_facilities: Services for people with special needs

contact_info.address: Middle East University, Amman-Jordan, Zip Code: 11831
